A scientist uses a radiation detector to monitor a sample of an isotope with a half-life of years. The count rate is recorded every seconds for one minute, as shown in the table below.

Time / sCount rate / counts
1084
2079
3088
4081
5085
6083

Which characteristic of radioactive decay is best demonstrated by the variation in the observed count rate?

  1. The decay constant of the isotope is decreasing over time.
  2. The radioactive decay of the nuclei is a random process.
  3. The sample is undergoing a measurable exponential decrease in activity.
  4. The rate of decay is being influenced by small changes in ambient pressure.
